name: Ada Lovelace
intro: Ada Lovelace: English mathematician (1815-1852) who wrote the first published algorithm intended for a machine, in her notes on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine. She is often called the first computer programmer.

name: Alan Turing
intro: Alan Turing: British mathematician (1912-1954) who described the Turing machine in 1936, helped break German Enigma ciphers at Bletchley Park during World War II, and proposed the Turing test for machine intelligence in 1950.

name: Grace Hopper
intro: Grace Hopper: American computer scientist and US Navy rear admiral (1906-1992). She built one of the first compilers and influenced the design of COBOL. She popularized the word 'bug' after a moth was found in the Harvard Mark II computer.

name: Tim Berners-Lee
intro: Tim Berners-Lee: British computer scientist who invented the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989 and founded the World Wide Web Consortium.

name: Linus Torvalds
intro: Linus Torvalds: Finnish-American software engineer who started the Linux kernel in 1991 as a student at the University of Helsinki, and created the Git version control system in 2005.

name: Edsger W. Dijkstra
intro: Edsger W. Dijkstra: Dutch computer scientist (1930-2002) known for his shortest path algorithm and the 1968 letter 'Go To Statement Considered Harmful'. He received the Turing Award in 1972.

name: Margaret Hamilton
intro: Margaret Hamilton: American computer scientist who led the team that wrote the onboard flight software for NASA's Apollo missions at the MIT Instrumentation Laboratory. She helped establish the term 'software engineering'.

name: Joe Armstrong
intro: Joe Armstrong: British computer scientist (1950-2019) who co-created the Erlang programming language at Ericsson's Computer Science Laboratory in Stockholm in 1986, for telephone switches that must never go down.

name: Michael Widenius
intro: Michael Widenius: Finnish programmer known as Monty, who co-founded MySQL AB in Sweden in 1995 with David Axmark and Allan Larsson. MySQL is named after his daughter My, and the later fork MariaDB after his younger daughter Maria.

name: Daniel Ek
intro: Daniel Ek: Swedish entrepreneur who co-founded the music streaming service Spotify in Stockholm in 2006 together with Martin Lorentzon.

name: Markus Persson
intro: Markus Persson: Swedish game developer known as Notch, who created Minecraft and founded the Stockholm studio Mojang. Microsoft bought Mojang in 2014 for 2.5 billion US dollars.

name: Barbara Liskov
intro: Barbara Liskov: American computer scientist known for the Liskov substitution principle in object-oriented design. She received the Turing Award in 2008.

name: Donald Knuth
intro: Donald Knuth: American computer scientist, author of the multi-volume 'The Art of Computer Programming' and creator of the TeX typesetting system. He sends a small reward check to anyone who finds an error in his books.

name: Zlatan Ibrahimović
intro: Zlatan Ibrahimović: Swedish striker born in Malmö in 1981 who played for Malmö FF, Ajax, Juventus, Inter, Barcelona, AC Milan, Paris Saint-Germain, Manchester United and LA Galaxy. He is Sweden's all-time top scorer with 62 international goals.

name: Pelé
intro: Pelé: Brazilian forward (1940-2022), the only player to win three FIFA World Cups (1958, 1962 and 1970). As a 17-year-old he scored twice in the 1958 final against Sweden at Råsunda in Solna, near Stockholm.

name: Lionel Messi
intro: Lionel Messi: Argentine forward who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar. He spent most of his career at FC Barcelona and has won the Ballon d'Or a record eight times.

name: Gunnar Gren
intro: Gunnar Gren: Swedish footballer (1920-1991) from Gothenburg who played for IFK Göteborg and AC Milan. He won Olympic gold in 1948 and was part of AC Milan's famous Gre-No-Li trio with Gunnar Nordahl and Nils Liedholm.

name: Sven-Göran Eriksson
intro: Sven-Göran Eriksson: Swedish football manager (1948-2024) who led IFK Göteborg to the UEFA Cup title in 1982 and later managed the England national team from 2001 to 2006.

name: Pia Sundhage
intro: Pia Sundhage: Swedish football player and coach who led the United States women's national team to Olympic gold in 2008 and 2012.

name: Marta Vieira da Silva
intro: Marta Vieira da Silva: Brazilian forward known as Marta, six-time FIFA World Player of the Year, who played in Sweden for Umeå IK and Tyresö FF.

name: Björn Borg
intro: Björn Borg: Swedish tennis player born in Södertälje in 1956 who won five consecutive Wimbledon titles from 1976 to 1980 and six French Open titles. He was famous for staying ice cool on court.

name: Stefan Edberg
intro: Stefan Edberg: Swedish tennis player from Västervik, a serve-and-volley specialist who won six Grand Slam singles titles, including Wimbledon in 1988 and 1990. He later coached Roger Federer.

name: Mats Wilander
intro: Mats Wilander: Swedish tennis player from Växjö who won seven Grand Slam singles titles, three of them in 1988, the year he also became world number one.

name: Serena Williams
intro: Serena Williams: American tennis player who won 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most in the Open Era, including the 2017 Australian Open while pregnant.

name: Roger Federer
intro: Roger Federer: Swiss tennis player who won 20 Grand Slam singles titles, including a record eight Wimbledon titles for men. He played his last match at the 2022 Laver Cup in London.

name: Peter Forsberg
intro: Peter Forsberg: Swedish ice hockey center from Örnsköldsvik who scored the famous shootout winner against Canada in the 1994 Olympic final in Lillehammer, later shown on a Swedish postage stamp. He won the Stanley Cup with Colorado in 1996 and 2001.

name: Nicklas Lidström
intro: Nicklas Lidström: Swedish defenseman from Västerås who spent his whole NHL career (1991-2012) with the Detroit Red Wings. He won four Stanley Cups and seven Norris Trophies, and in 2008 became the first European-born captain to win the Stanley Cup.

name: Mats Sundin
intro: Mats Sundin: Swedish center born in Bromma, Stockholm, who in 1989 became the first European player drafted first overall in the NHL, and later captained the Toronto Maple Leafs.

name: Henrik Lundqvist
intro: Henrik Lundqvist: Swedish goaltender from Åre who played for Frölunda HC in Gothenburg before 15 seasons with the New York Rangers, and won Olympic gold with Sweden in 2006. His twin brother Joel also played for Frölunda.

name: Wayne Gretzky
intro: Wayne Gretzky: Canadian center known as The Great One, who holds the NHL record for career points. His number 99 is retired across the entire league.

name: Hayley Wickenheiser
intro: Hayley Wickenheiser: Canadian ice hockey forward who won four Olympic gold medals (2002, 2006, 2010 and 2014) and also played professional men's hockey in Finland.

name: Valentino Rossi
intro: Valentino Rossi: Italian motorcycle racer from Tavullia, nine-time Grand Prix world champion including seven titles in the premier class, famous for racing with number 46. He retired in 2021.

name: Giacomo Agostini
intro: Giacomo Agostini: Italian motorcycle racer who won a record 15 Grand Prix world championships in the 1960s and 1970s, eight in the 500cc class and seven in the 350cc class.

name: Marc Márquez
intro: Marc Márquez: Spanish motorcycle racer who in 2013 became the youngest premier-class world champion, in his first MotoGP season, riding for Honda.

name: Casey Stoner
intro: Casey Stoner: Australian motorcycle racer who won the MotoGP title with Ducati in 2007 and with Honda in 2011, then retired at 27.

name: Ayrton Senna
intro: Ayrton Senna: Brazilian Formula 1 driver who won three world championships (1988, 1990 and 1991) with McLaren and was famous for his qualifying speed and wet-weather driving. He died after a crash at Imola in 1994.

name: Michael Schumacher
intro: Michael Schumacher: German Formula 1 driver who won seven world championships, two with Benetton (1994 and 1995) and five in a row with Ferrari (2000-2004).

name: Lewis Hamilton
intro: Lewis Hamilton: British Formula 1 driver who won seven world championships, the first with McLaren in 2008 and six with Mercedes, and moved to Ferrari for the 2025 season.

name: Max Verstappen
intro: Max Verstappen: Dutch Formula 1 driver who won four consecutive world championships with Red Bull Racing from 2021 to 2024.

name: Ronnie Peterson
intro: Ronnie Peterson: Swedish Formula 1 driver from Örebro (1944-1978), known as SuperSwede, who finished runner-up in the championship in 1971 and 1978. He died after a start crash at Monza in 1978.

name: Gunnar Nilsson
intro: Gunnar Nilsson: Swedish Formula 1 driver (1948-1978) who won the 1977 Belgian Grand Prix at Zolder for Lotus. After his death from cancer, a cancer foundation was started in his name.

name: Lella Lombardi
intro: Lella Lombardi: Italian racing driver who remains the only woman to score points in a Formula 1 world championship race, with half a point at the 1975 Spanish Grand Prix.

name: Marcus Ericsson
intro: Marcus Ericsson: Swedish racing driver from Kumla who raced in Formula 1 for Caterham and Sauber, then won the Indianapolis 500 in 2022.

name: Hilma af Klint
intro: Hilma af Klint: Swedish painter (1862-1944) born at Karlberg Palace in Solna, who made large abstract paintings years before Kandinsky. She asked that her abstract work not be shown until 20 years after her death.

name: Carl Larsson
intro: Carl Larsson: Swedish painter (1853-1919) known for watercolors of family life in his home Lilla Hyttnäs in Sundborn, Dalarna.

name: Anders Zorn
intro: Anders Zorn: Swedish painter (1860-1920) from Mora, famous for his portraits and the way he painted water. The Zorn Museum in Mora holds much of his work.

name: Carl Milles
intro: Carl Milles: Swedish sculptor (1875-1955) whose home and sculpture garden Millesgården is on Lidingö near Stockholm. His Poseidon statue stands at Götaplatsen in Gothenburg.

name: Frida Kahlo
intro: Frida Kahlo: Mexican painter (1907-1954) known for intense self-portraits, many painted after a bus accident left her in lifelong pain. Her home, the Blue House in Coyoacán, is now a museum.

name: Vincent van Gogh
intro: Vincent van Gogh: Dutch painter (1853-1890) who painted 'The Starry Night' in 1889 while staying at the asylum in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. He sold very few paintings during his lifetime.

name: Yayoi Kusama
intro: Yayoi Kusama: Japanese artist known for polka dots, pumpkins and immersive mirrored 'Infinity Room' installations.

name: Alfred Nobel
intro: Alfred Nobel: Swedish chemist and engineer (1833-1896) born in Stockholm who invented dynamite and left most of his fortune to fund the Nobel Prizes.

name: Greta Garbo
intro: Greta Garbo: Swedish actress (1905-1990) born in Stockholm who became a Hollywood star in the 1920s and 1930s, and later lived a famously private life in New York.

name: Ingrid Bergman
intro: Ingrid Bergman: Swedish actress (1915-1982) born in Stockholm, who starred in 'Casablanca' and won three Academy Awards.

name: Astrid Lindgren
intro: Astrid Lindgren: Swedish author (1907-2002) from Vimmerby who wrote 'Pippi Longstocking' and lived for decades in an apartment on Dalagatan in Stockholm, facing Vasaparken.

name: Tim Bergling
intro: Tim Bergling: Swedish DJ and producer from Stockholm (1989-2018), known as Avicii, behind the hits 'Levels' and 'Wake Me Up'.

name: Greta Thunberg
intro: Greta Thunberg: Swedish climate activist born in Stockholm in 2003, who started a school strike for the climate outside the Swedish parliament in August 2018.

name: Benny Andersson
intro: Benny Andersson: Swedish musician from Stockholm and member of ABBA, which won the Eurovision Song Contest in 1974 with 'Waterloo'. He later co-wrote the musical 'Chess'.

name: Evert Taube
intro: Evert Taube: Swedish troubadour and writer (1890-1976) born in Gothenburg, who grew up on the lighthouse island of Vinga where his father was the lighthouse keeper. Many of his songs are about the sea.

name: Assar Gabrielsson
intro: Assar Gabrielsson: Swedish businessman (1891-1962) who co-founded Volvo with Gustaf Larson. The first series-produced Volvo car left the factory in Gothenburg in April 1927.

name: Håkan Hellström
intro: Håkan Hellström: Swedish singer and songwriter from Gothenburg whose songs often mention the city. He has played sold-out concerts at Ullevi stadium.

name: Bruce Springsteen
intro: Bruce Springsteen: American rock musician. His 1985 concerts at Ullevi in Gothenburg are legendary in Sweden, where the jumping crowd reportedly made the whole stadium shake.

name: Gustav II Adolf
intro: Gustav II Adolf: King of Sweden (1594-1632) who founded the city of Gothenburg in 1621 and ordered the warship Vasa, which sank in Stockholm harbor on its maiden voyage in 1628. He was killed at the Battle of Lützen.

name: Queen Christina
intro: Queen Christina: Queen of Sweden (1626-1689) who gave up the throne in 1654, converted to Catholicism and moved to Rome, where she is buried in St. Peter's Basilica.

name: Carl Linnaeus
intro: Carl Linnaeus: Swedish botanist (1707-1778) at Uppsala University who created the two-part Latin naming system for species, such as Homo sapiens.

name: Anders Celsius
intro: Anders Celsius: Swedish astronomer (1701-1744) from Uppsala who proposed the temperature scale named after him. In his original version, 0 was the boiling point of water and 100 the freezing point.

name: Marie Curie
intro: Marie Curie: Polish-French physicist and chemist (1867-1934), the first woman to win a Nobel Prize and the only person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences, physics in 1903 and chemistry in 1911.

name: Leonardo da Vinci
intro: Leonardo da Vinci: Italian painter, engineer and inventor (1452-1519) who painted the Mona Lisa and filled notebooks with designs for flying machines, written in mirror script.

name: Raoul Wallenberg
intro: Raoul Wallenberg: Swedish diplomat who in 1944 in Budapest saved thousands of Hungarian Jews by issuing protective passports. He disappeared after being detained by Soviet forces in 1945.

name: Cleopatra
intro: Cleopatra: Cleopatra VII (69-30 BC), the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, known for her alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony.

name: Björn Borg
intro: Björn Borg: Plumber in Mölndal, no relation to the tennis player. He has heard the Wimbledon joke at every job since 1994 and now answers that his pipe repairs also last five years in a row.

name: Elin Rosengren
intro: Elin Rosengren: Data engineer at Lingonberry Systems in Gothenburg who keeps four beehives on the roof of the office at Lindholmen. Every colleague gets a jar of Lindholmen honey at Christmas.

name: Oskar Lind
intro: Oskar Lind: Database administrator in Stockholm who moved his company's sharded MySQL order database to TiDB over one long weekend. He keeps the old shard map framed above his desk as a reminder of darker times.

name: Nadia Haddad
intro: Nadia Haddad: Go-kart enthusiast who holds the adult lap record of 1:42.318 at a small indoor track in Kungälv. The rest of the week she drives a 2009 Volvo V70, very slowly.

name: Johan Berg
intro: Johan Berg: IT support technician at Lingonberry Systems who wrote incident report INC-2041 after a leaking coffee machine flooded the server room on a Friday afternoon. Coffee has been banned on the third floor ever since.

name: Lisa Ekström
intro: Lisa Ekström: Surfinstruktör i Varberg på somrarna och Rust-utvecklare på vintrarna. Hon har lärt över 300 nybörjare att stå på brädan och vägrar fortfarande att använda tabbar i koden.

name: Marco Bellini
intro: Marco Bellini: Motorcycle mechanic in Pesaro who painted the number 46 on his first moped at age 14 and has not missed a single MotoGP weekend at Misano since.

name: Sara Nyström
intro: Sara Nyström: Has driven the ice resurfacing machine at Scandinavium in Gothenburg for 15 years. She claims she can tell the score of a Frölunda game just by looking at the ice afterwards.

name: Ahmed Karimi
intro: Ahmed Karimi: Night-shift tram driver on line 11 in Gothenburg who knows every stop by heart, and the best kebab place near each one.

name: Karin Holm
intro: Karin Holm: Racket stringer at the Stockholm Open for 22 years. She has strung rackets for several world number ones but signed an agreement never to say who.

name: Erik Johansson
intro: Erik Johansson: Amateur goalkeeper in a sixth-division ice hockey team in Partille who once stopped 41 shots in a single game and still lost 1-2.

name: Zlatan Andersson
intro: Zlatan Andersson: Amateur football goalkeeper in Lerum, no relation to Zlatan Ibrahimović despite the name. He saved three penalties in a row in the 2019 local cup final and has told the story at every party since.

name: Maja Lundgren
intro: Maja Lundgren: Art restorer at a Stockholm museum who specializes in gilded 19th-century picture frames. She once spent 400 hours on a single frame and calls it her golden summer.

name: Tobias Wikström
intro: Tobias Wikström: Street artist in Gothenburg who paints tiny seagull murals on electrical boxes around Majorna. Nobody knows what he looks like, and he only posts photos of new works at 4 in the morning.

name: Hanna Sjöberg
intro: Hanna Sjöberg: Tour guide on Djurgården in Stockholm who tells the story of the Vasa ship dressed as a 17th-century sailor, and ends every tour by pretending to sink.

name: Per Åkesson
intro: Per Åkesson: Winter swimmer who has bathed in Riddarfjärden in central Stockholm every morning in January for 12 years. His record is 31 days in a row with ice on the water.

name: Fatima Osei
intro: Fatima Osei: Site reliability engineer who has been on call for three New Year's Eves in a row. She has a pet hedgehog named Dijkstra who always finds the shortest path to the food bowl.

name: Gustav Lindahl
intro: Gustav Lindahl: Pizza chef in Haga, Gothenburg, who has named a pizza after every Formula 1 world champion. The Senna with extra chili is the bestseller, and the Verstappen sells out every Sunday.

name: Ingrid Falk
intro: Ingrid Falk: Retired history teacher in Uppsala who has read every letter by Carl Linnaeus she could find online, and politely corrects tour guides who get his plant names wrong.

name: Leo Andersson
intro: Leo Andersson: Computer science student in Linköping who beat his professor at chess in 14 moves and now gets challenged at every department party.

name: Mei Lin
intro: Mei Lin: Backend developer at Lingonberry Systems who writes all her code in Python and refuses to use semicolons anywhere, including in text messages.

name: Jonas Ek
intro: Jonas Ek: Office manager at Lingonberry Systems who ordered the coffee machine behind the flooded server room, and has not been allowed to buy any appliances since.

name: Sofia Martins
intro: Sofia Martins: Portuguese nurse in Malmö who plays the nyckelharpa, a traditional Swedish keyed fiddle, in a folk band called Kvarnen Trio.

name: Anders Bäck
intro: Anders Bäck: Carpenter from Rättvik in Dalarna who builds nyckelharpas by hand. Each instrument takes about 200 hours, and he has a two-year waiting list.

name: Yuki Tanaka
intro: Yuki Tanaka: ストックホルム在住の日本人パン職人。毎週金曜日にシナモンロールと抹茶入りのカルダモンパンを焼き、開店前にはいつも行列ができる。

name: Chen Wei
intro: Chen Wei: 住在哥德堡的软件测试工程师，业余时间收集旧的瑞典火车票，已经收藏了一千多张。

name: Emil Strand
intro: Emil Strand: Groundskeeper at the clay courts in Båstad who has raked the center court before every Swedish Open final since 2005.

name: Rebecka Olsson
intro: Rebecka Olsson: Marathon runner who ran the Stockholm Marathon dressed as a giant cinnamon bun and finished in 3 hours and 58 minutes.

name: Viktor Nilsson
intro: Viktor Nilsson: Mountain rescue volunteer in Åre who skied the World Cup slope backwards for charity in 11 minutes.

name: Amira Sayed
intro: Amira Sayed: Patent lawyer in Stockholm who has worked on 140 patents. Her favorite is a self-stirring lingonberry jam jar invented by a farmer in Småland.

name: Karl-Erik Svensson
intro: Karl-Erik Svensson: Retired Volvo factory worker from Torslanda who says he tightened the last bolt on more than 250,000 cars. He still drives his 1987 Volvo 240.

name: Olivia Brandt
intro: Olivia Brandt: Astronomy teacher in Kiruna who has photographed the northern lights on 600 different nights, and insists she once saw them in the middle of July.

name: Daniel Okafor
intro: Daniel Okafor: E-sports commentator in Stockholm who commentated a Minecraft speedrun final for nine hours without a break.

name: Saga Lindberg
intro: Saga Lindberg: Performer at the Liseberg amusement park in Gothenburg who has played the park's rabbit mascot for 18 years.

name: Hugo Lindqvist
intro: Hugo Lindqvist: Retired crane operator from the Eriksberg shipyard in Gothenburg who now volunteers restoring old harbor cranes and knows every rivet by name.

name: Rolf Hansson
intro: Rolf Hansson: Hobby inventor in Borås who insists he invented the World Wide Web in his garage in 1987, two years before Tim Berners-Lee, but lost the floppy disk.

name: Alejandra Caldera
intro: Alejandra Caldera: Alejandra delights in reinventing classic dishes such as enchiladas with mole, carnitas tacos topped with freshly picked cilantro and lime, and pineapple-infused salsa verde, skillfully blending garden-grown herbs, heirloom corn masa.

name: Johnny Jackson
intro: Johnny Jackson: Johnny spends mornings fishing the Kanawha River, hikes local Blue Ridge trails in summer, follows the Charleston RiverDogs minor-league baseball team, and participates in the senior center’s bridge league.

name: Noemi Caraveo
intro: Noemi Caraveo: Noemi is a quietly ambitious pharmacy technician who merges scientific precision with artistic empathy, thrives in solitary creative spaces, and balances disciplined savings with occasional indulgences.

name: Samuel Pino
intro: Samuel Pino: Samuel immerses themselves in classic country and gospel music, frequently listening to Johnny Cash, Dolly Parton, and the Blind Boys of Alabama, while collecting Southern folklore anthologies by authors such as George Curry.

name: Steve Vidal
intro: Steve Vidal: Steve regularly attends jazz concerts featuring the legacy of Miles Davis at the Kennedy Center and enjoys theater productions by the Shakespeare Theatre Company; they spend their evenings reading biographies of figures like Dr.

name: Carolina Bayas
intro: Carolina Bayas: Carolina navigates retirement with a blend of seasoned financial acumen, artistic curiosity, and community-focused generosity, balancing meticulous spreadsheets with watercolor splashes, and they occasionally forget about their medication.

name: William Frey
intro: William Frey: William is a curious yet disorganized 65-year-old retiree who blends a love of art, nature, and competition, spending mornings photographing sunrise over Lake Coeur d’Alene and afternoons debating gallery shows, all.

name: Shell Minton
intro: Shell Minton: Shell is a creatively curious boutique manager-in-training whose meticulous eye for detail coexists with a restless anxiety that fuels both artistic passion and occasional impulsive spending.

name: Ana Ferrera
intro: Ana Ferrera: Ana channels their sociable energy into teaching salsa at a community center, drawing inspiration from legendary performers like Celia Cruz and contemporary photographer Vivian Maier, while they also binge-read sci-fi by authors such as N.

name: Aaleeyah Newson
intro: Aaleeyah Newson: Aaleeyah plays pickup basketball at the local community center during summer and follows the St. Louis Cardinals, St. Louis Blues, and St. Louis City SC avidly.

name: Bichngoc Camatcho
intro: Bichngoc Camatcho: Bichngoc enjoys weekend hikes in Red Rock Canyon, follows the Las Vegas Aces and Denver Broncos, practices yoga twice a week for flexibility, and joins a local recreational softball league for cardio and camaraderie.

name: Alina Charpia
intro: Alina Charpia: Alina, a methodical traveler who favors serene coastal retreats, has explored the Oregon Coast, the Scottish Highlands, and the Greek islands of Crete and Santorini, and now dreams of a slow-travel itinerary through Norway's fjords.

name: Ahmed John
intro: Ahmed John: Ahmed cultivates his creative side by listening to Ravi Shankar and John Coltrane while restoring vintage furniture, attending the local symphony’s performances of Beethoven, studying Ansel Adams photographic prints for inspiration.

name: Annie Lamar
intro: Annie Lamar: Annie hits the local hiking trails with their family on weekends, participates in the annual charity 5K run, supports the Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, and belongs to a community running club that meets for early-morning jogs.

name: Christ Myles
intro: Christ Myles: Christ blends scientific rigor with artistic spontaneity, juggling CRISPR experiments, guitar riffs, and spontaneous hikes while wrestling with a charmingly disorganized schedule that keeps both his lab bench and his life intriguingly fluid.

name: Minh Vu
intro: Minh Vu: Minh blends meticulous compliance expertise with a solitary artistic soul, harmonizing data-driven precision and quiet curiosity, and they occasionally indulge in impulsive splurges on premium watercolor supplies.

name: Edith Coleman
intro: Edith Coleman: Edith enjoys low-impact fitness, attending Saturday sunrise yoga at Maymont Park, cheering on the Richmond Flying Squirrels during spring baseball.

name: Lan Kim
intro: Lan Kim: Lan blends meticulous surveillance skills with a compassionate heart, navigates retirement finances with cautious optimism, tends to anxiety through mindfulness and gardening, and occasionally overchecks details.

name: Kristofer Day
intro: Kristofer Day: Kristofer, a seasoned elementary and middle-school science teacher on the verge of retirement, they merge a deep STEM expertise with a love for hands-on tinkering, crafting inquiry-based curricula, mentoring colleagues.

name: Alexander Mcauliffe
intro: Alexander Mcauliffe: Alexander, a dedicated recreational soccer player for the Midtown United club, fuels his weekend matches with competitive drive, cheers loudly for the Atlanta Falcons and Atlanta United.

name: Brittany Cole
intro: Brittany Cole: Brittany enjoys Sunday afternoons cheering on the Atlanta Braves and the Atlanta Falcons while playing in a co-ed adult softball league and attending a weekend yoga class at the community center, and they use this mix of spectating.

name: Elliot Perry
intro: Elliot Perry: Elliot stays fit by joining pickup basketball games at the Lawrenceville courts, rooting for the Pittsburgh Steelers in football season and the Pittsburgh Penguins in hockey.

name: Reginald Caballero
intro: Reginald Caballero: Reginald, who prefers meticulously planned itineraries over spontaneous trips, they have explored Boston’s Freedom Trail, taken a weekend river cruise through the Hudson Valley, spent a summer in Tuscany sampling vineyard tours.

name: Robert Klap
intro: Robert Klap: Robert channels their relentless competitive drive and vivid imagination into a disciplined, data-obsessed sales career, while battling bouts of anxiety that fuel late-night paint sessions and impulsive gadget purchases.

name: Jennifer Velez
intro: Jennifer Velez: Jennifer favors flexible, culturally immersive trips, having explored the colonial charm of San Miguel de Allende, relaxed on the Gulf Coast’s Galveston beaches, taken a spontaneous road trip to Austin’s music scene.

name: William Coleman
intro: William Coleman: William enjoys New England staples like lobster roll, clam chowder, and baked cod, often cooking with fresh-caught fish and locally sourced herbs, experiments with sourdough pizza on his DIY wood-fire oven.

name: Dayanara Martinez
intro: Dayanara Martinez: Dayanara blends relentless organization with heartfelt community service, keeping a meticulous daily journal, juggling bilingual casework, and they habitually over-season their cooking, much to the delight of friends.

name: Karen Deridder
intro: Karen Deridder: Karen experiments with seasonal produce from the Allentown farmers’ market, crafting dishes like miso-glazed salmon with beets, homemade kimchi, and rosemary-infused focaccia.

name: Kimoanh Nguyen
intro: Kimoanh Nguyen: Kimoanh specializes in pho broth simmered with locally sourced beef bones, bánh chưng wrapped in banana leaves using home-grown herbs, and creates specialty sauces like lemongrass-chili vinaigrette.

name: Stephanie Burket
intro: Stephanie Burket: Stephanie, a moderately skilled home cook, delights in crafting avocado-lime tacos, mastering the balance of smoked paprika in grilled salmon, and sampling artisanal charcuterie at new pop-up eateries.

name: Christopher Pullen
intro: Christopher Pullen: Christopher is a pragmatic yet curious 23-year-old bar enthusiast who balances craft-beer sampling with disciplined budgeting, hikes to reset, strums guitar after work, and dreams of a community brewpub.

name: Jacquelyn Bailey
intro: Jacquelyn Bailey: Jacquelyn immerses herself in contemporary fiction, often discussing works by authors like Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie and Celeste Ng in her book club, and regularly attends jazz performances by Kamasi Washington.

name: Linda Joyner
intro: Linda Joyner: Linda, a devoted lover of classic country and gospel music, fills her home with the sounds of Dolly Parton, Willie Nelson, and The Oak Ridge Boys, participates in the church choir rehearsals.

name: Anna Chandarana
intro: Anna Chandarana: Anna delights in fusion Southern-Indian cooking, frequently preparing dishes like mango-chili glazed fried catfish, cumin-spiced cornbread topped with paneer crumbles.

name: Arthur Motley
intro: Arthur Motley: Arthur, a routine-driven police officer with a competitive edge, balances disciplined fitness, classic car restoration, and soulful blues while occasionally indulging in late-night BBQ cravings.

name: Antoinette Elmore
intro: Antoinette Elmore: Antoinette, a 31-year-old marathoner, logs early morning runs along the American River Trail with the Sacramento Runners Club, competes in the annual American River 5K, follows the Sacramento Kings.

name: Rosa Gordon
intro: Rosa Gordon: Rosa nurtures their love of music by singing in the Baptist church choir and immersing themselves in classic R&B and jazz recordings by Aretha Franklin, Marvin Gaye, Ella Fitzgerald, and Louis Armstrong.

name: Ella Dieudonne
intro: Ella Dieudonne: Ella delights in cooking heirloom vegetable ratatouille, slow-roasted rosemary chicken, and apple-cinnamon crumble, drawing fresh herbs from their garden, and while their culinary skills are modest.

name: George Riley
intro: George Riley: George channels their creative imagination through delicate watercolors of prairie sunsets inspired by the works of Albert Bierstadt and captures sweeping river valley photographs in the style of Ansel Adams.

name: Robin Kent
intro: Robin Kent: Robin engages deeply with the visual and performing arts, creating mixed-media paintings that echo the bold colors of Georgia O'Keeffe and the collage techniques of Andy Warhol, curating local gallery shows.

name: Matthew Boswell
intro: Matthew Boswell: Matthew’s palate is dominated by craft-beer experimentation, especially citrus-laden IPAs, paired with Pacific Northwest staples like cedar-plank salmon and mushroom risotto, and they boast a reliable sourdough starter.

name: James Henry
